air-elemental.name: Air Elemental
desc: An air elemental is a funneling cloud of whirling air with a vague semblance of a face. Although it likes to race across the ground, picking up dust and debris as it goes, it can also fly and attack from above.
An air elemental can turn itself into a screaming cyclone, creating a whirlwind that batters creatures even as it flings them away.

abilities.name: Languages
abilities.desc: The elemental speaks and understands Auran.

abilities.name: Air Form
abilities.desc: The elemental may enter a creature's space and stop there. It may move through a space as narrow as 1in. wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes 2 slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 2d8 + 5 @bludgeoning damage.

name: Whirlwind
Recharge 4-6
actions.desc: Each creature in the elemental's space must make a DC 13 STR saving throw, taking 3d8 + 2 @bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, on a failure, a target is flung up to 20ft. away from the elemental in a random direction, and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes an object, such as a wall or the floor, or creature, the target takes 1d6 @bludgeoning damage for every 10ft. it was thrown. If the target hits another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 DEX saving throw, or take the same damage, and be knocked prone.

earth-elemental.name: Earth Elemental
desc: An earth elemental plods forward like a walking hill, club-like arms of jagged stone swinging at its sides. Its head and body consist of dirt and stone, occasionally set with chunks of metal, gems, and bright minerals.

Earth elementals glide through rock and earth as though they were liquid. Earthbound creatures have much to fear from an earth elemental, since the elemental can pinpoint the precise location of any foe that stands on solid ground in its vicinity.

abilities.name: Languages
abilities.desc: The elemental speaks and understands Terran.

abilities.name: Earth Glide
abilities.desc: The elemental may burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. It does so without disturbing the material it moves through.

abilities.name: Siege Monster
abilities.desc: The elemental deals double damage against objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes 2 slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 2d8 + 5 @bludgeoning damage.

fire-elemental.name: Fire Elemental
desc: A faint humanoid shape threads through the core of this wild, moving flame. A fire elemental is a force of capricious devastation. Wherever it moves, it sets its surroundings ablaze, turning the world to ash, smoke, and cinders. Water can halt its destructive progress, causing the fire elemental to shrink back, hissing and smoking in pain and rage.

abilities.name: Languages
abilities.desc: The elemental speaks and understands Ignan.

abilities.name: Fire Form
abilities.desc: The elemental may move through a space as narrow as 1in. wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental, or hits it with a melee attack while within 5ft. of it takes 1d10 @fire damage. Additionally, the elemental may enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 1d10 @fire damage, and catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 1d10 @fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

abilities.name: Illumination
abilities.desc: The elemental sheds bright light in a 30ft. radius, and dim light in an additional 30ft.

abilities.name: Water Susceptibility
abilities.desc: For every 5ft. the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, the elemental takes 1 @cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes 2 touch attacks.

actions.name: Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 + 3 @fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 1d10 @fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

fox.name: Fox
desc: The white arctic foxes of Icewind Dale live in burrows and are acclimated to cold weather. They prowl the outskirts of Ten-Towns and nearby forests for food, hunting hares or stealing fish. These timid creatures avoid contact with humanoids, but they are sometimes used as mounts by chwingas.

abilities.name: Keen Hearing
abilities.desc: The fox gains advantage on Perception (WIS) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

fox.source: Icewind Dale - Rime of the Frostmaiden

grim.name: Grim
desc: The grim is summoned as part of the Grim Harbinger Ranger Conclave.
grim.hitpoints: 5 + 5 * your ranger level. The grim has a number of hit dice (1d8) equal to your ranger level.

abilities.name: Languages
abilities.desc: The grim understands the languages you speak, but cannot speak.

abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
abilities.desc: The grim may move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The grim takes 1d10 @force damage if it ends its turn inside a solid object.

abilities.name: Shared Fate
abilities.desc: The grim may add your proficiency to any ability check or saving throw it makes.

actions.name: Ominous Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5ft., one target you can see. Hit: 1d6 + your WIS @necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is frightened of the grim until the start of your next turn.

reactions.name: Baleful Howl
reactions.desc: Whenever a creature moves out of the grim's reach, the target must succeed on a WIS saving throw against your spell save DC, or have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

steel-defender.name: Steel Defender
desc: The steel defender is summoned as part of the Battle Smith Artificer Specialism.
steel-defender.hitpoints: 2 + your INT + 5 * your artificer level. The defender has a number of hit dice (1d8) equal to your artificer level.

abilities.name: Languages
abilities.desc: The defender understands the languages you speak, but cannot speak.

abilities.name: Vigilant
abilities.desc: The defender cannot be surprised.

actions.name: Force-Empowered Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5ft., one target you can see. Hit: 1d8 + proficiency @force damage.

name: Repair
3/day
actions.desc: The magical mechanisms inside the defender restore 2d8 + proficiency hitpoints to itself, or to a construct or object within 5ft. of it.

tarrasque.name: Tarrasque
desc: The legendary tarrasque is possibly the most dreaded monster of the Material Plane. It is widely believed that only one of these creatures exists, though no one can predict where and when it will strike.

A scaly biped, the tarrasque is fifty feet tall and seventy feet long, weighing hundreds of tons. It carries itself like a bird of prey, leaning forward and using its powerful lashing tail for balance. Its cavernous maw yawns wide enough to swallow all but the largest creatures, and so great is its hunger that it can devour the populations of whole towns.

name: Legendary Resistance
3/day
abilities.desc: Whenever the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.desc: The tarrasque gains advantage on saving throws against spells, and other magical effects.

abilities.name: Reflective Carapace
abilities.desc: Whenever the tarrasque is targeted by the @magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, the tarrasque is unaffected by the spell. Roll 1d6. On a 6, the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from the tarrasque, turning the caster into the target.

abilities.name: Siege Monster
abilities.desc: The tarrasque deals double damage against objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tarrasque may use its frightful presence. It then makes 5 attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail. It may use its swallow instead of its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 4d12 + 10 @piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grapped, escape DC 20. While grappled in this way, the target is restrained, and the tarrasque cannot use the bite action against another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15ft., one target. Hit: 4d8 + 10 @slashing damage.

actions.name: Horns
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 4d10 + 10 @piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 20ft., one target. Hit: 4d6 + 10 @bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 STR saving throw, or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the tarrasque's choice within 120ft. of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 17 WIS saving throw, or become frightened of it for 1 minute. A creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the tarrasque is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful, or the effect ends for it, the creature becomes immune to the tarrasque's frightful presence for 24 hours.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The tarrasque makes a bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, gains total cover against attacks and effects outside the tarrasque, and takes 16d6 @acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns. Whenever the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 CON saving throw at the end of that turn, or regurgitate all swallowed creatures. Regurgitated creatures exit the tarrasque prone, in a space within 10ft. of the tarrasque. If the tarrasque dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained, and may escape the tarrasque by using 30ft. of movement, exiting prone.

water-elemental.name: Water Elemental
desc: A water elemental is a cresting wave that rolls across the ground, becoming nearly invisible at it courses through a larger body of water. It engulfs creatures that stand against it, filling their mouths and lungs as easily as it smothers flame.

abilities.name: Languages
abilities.desc: The elemental speaks and understands Aquan.

abilities.name: Freeze
abilities.desc: Whenever the elemental takes @cold damage, it partially freezes, reducing its speed by 20ft. until the end of its next turn.

abilities.name: Water Form
abilities.desc: The elemental may enter a creature's space and stop there. It may move through a space as narrow as 1in. wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes 2 slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 2d8 + 4 @bludgeoning damage.

name: Whelm
Recharge 4-6
actions.desc: Each creature in the elemental's space must succeed on a DC 15 STR saving throw, or take 2d8 + 4 @bludgeoning damage, and if it is Large or smaller, be grappled, escape DC 14. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and is unable to breathe, unless the creature is able to breathe water. On a success, the target is pushed out of the elemental's space. The elemental may grapple 1 Large creature, or up to 2 Medium or smaller creatures at any one time. At the start of each of the elemental's turns, each target grappled by it takes 2d8 + 4 @bludgeoning damage. A creature within 5ft. of the elemental may pull a creature or object out of it by, as an action, succeeding on a DC 14 STR check.

catalytic-automaton.name: Catalytic Automaton
desc: The catalytic automaton is summoned as part of the Catalyst Warlock Patron.
catalytic-automaton.hitpoints: 2 + your CHA + 5 * your warlock level. The autotomaton has a number of hit dice (1d8) equal to your warlock level.

abilities.name: Languages
abilities.desc: The defender understands the languages you speak, but cannot speak.

abilities.name: Servant of the Preserver
abilities.desc: The automaton's weapon attacks count as magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The automaton makes an amount of bash attacks equal to its proficiency.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5ft., one target you can see. Hit: 1d6 + proficiency @bludgeoning damage.

name: Piercing Scream
1/day
actions.desc: The automaton lets out a piercing shockwave, affecting every creature in a cone with a length of 10ft. + 5ft. * proficiency. Creatures in the area must succeed on a CHA saving throw, or take 1d4 + proficiency @psychic damage, and gain vulnerability to @force damage until the start of the automaton's next turn.

adult-black-dragon.name: Adult Black Dragon
desc: The most evil-tempered and vile of the chromatic dragons, black dragons collect the wreckage and treasures of fallen peoples. These dragons loathe seeing the weak prosper, and revel in the collapse of humanoid kingdoms. They make their homes in fetid swamps and crumbling ruins where kingdoms once stood.

abilities.name: Languages
abilities.desc: The dragon speaks and understands Common and Draconic.

abilities.name: Swamp Dweller
abilities.desc: The dragon can breathe both air and water. Additionally, the dragon may ignore difficult terrain induced by swampy terrain.

name: Legendary Resistance
3/day, 4/day in lair
abilities.desc: Whenever the dragon fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes 3 rend attacks. It may forego 1 of these attacks to cast the @acid arrow spell as a 3rd level spell.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 + 6 @slashing damage + 1d8 @acid damage.

name: Acid Breath
Recharge 5-6
actions.desc: The dragon exhales destructive draconic energy in a 60ft. by 5ft. line. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 DEX saving throw, taking 12d8 @acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: Calling on the corrosive streams of draconic power, black dragons may cast spells. Its spellcasting ability is INT, spell save DC of 17, +9 to hit. The dragon requires no material components.

actions.name: Dissolution
actions.desc: The dragon targets a willing creature it can see within 15ft. of it. The creature turns into a sphere, equal to its original size, of acidic vapor, as if it is affected by the @gaseous form spell. A creature dissolved in this way may enter another creature's space and stop there. A creature moving through, or ending its turn inside the space of such a cloud takes 4d10 @acid damage. The creature reverts to its original form after 1 minute, unless the creature is reduced to 0 hitpoints, in which case the cloud becomes harmless and non-magical, dissipating almost instantly. The dragon may maintain up to 2 dissolved creatures at a time.

legendaryActions.desc: The dragon may take 3 legendary actions, or 4 in its lair, choosing from the options below. Only 1 option may be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

content.name: Pounce
content.desc: The dragon may move up to half its speed, and may make 1 rend attack.

name: Wing Beat
Costs 2 legendary actions
content.desc: The dragon beats its mighty, tattered wings. All creatures within 10ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 16 STR saving throw, or take 2d6 @bludgeoning damage, and be knocked prone. The dragon may then move up to half its flying speed.

lairActions.desc: While the dragon is in its lair, it gains access to the following lair actions. These may be used at initiative count 20, losing initiative ties.

content.name: Reacidify
content.desc: The dragon drinks from a nearby acid reserve, partially refilling its acid glands. If the dragon's breath weapon is on cooldown, it may make another recharge check. On a failure, or if the dragon's breath weapon is not recharging, the dragon's next rend attack deals an extra 3d8 @acid damage.

content.name: Cloud of Insects
content.desc: The dragon rips open part of the soil, and summons a swarm of toxic vermin. A creature of the dragon's choice it can see within 120ft. of it must succeed on a DC 17 DEX saving throw, or take 4d10 @poison damage and gain disadvantage on CON saving throws to maintain concentration until the end of its next turn.

content.name: Silkhole
content.desc: The surrounding bog rumbles. All creatures except for the dragon must roll 1d12. Creatures within 10ft. of water they cannot stand in roll 1d6 instead. On a 1, the creature sinks into the murky waters, and is knocked prone. Unless the creature is able to breathe water, it takes 2d8 @acid damage + 2d8 @poison damage, and is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

adult-black-dragon.source: Azzurey's Destructive Dictionary of Draconic Discord

adult-white-dragon.name: Adult White Dragon
desc: TThe smallest, least intelligent, and most animalistic of the chromatic dragons, white dragons dwell in frigid climes, favoring arctic areas or icy mountains. They are vicious, cruel reptiles driven by hunger and greed.

abilities.name: Languages
abilities.desc: The dragon speaks and understands Common and Draconic.

abilities.name: Cryogenic
abilities.desc: The dragon is able to traverse icy terrain without needing a skill check, and may ignore difficult terrain induced by ice and snow. Additionally, the dragon can breathe both air and water.

name: Legendary Resistance
3/day, 4/day in lair
abilities.desc: Whenever the dragon fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes 3 rend attacks. It may forego 1 of these attacks to cast the @binding ice spell as a 3rd level spell.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 + 6 @slashing damage + 1d8 @cold damage.

name: Freezing Breath
Recharge 5-6
actions.desc: The dragon exhales destructive draconic energy in a 30ft. cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 DEX saving throw, taking 8d10 @cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, on a failure, the creature is encased in magical ice. An encased creature is restrained, and gains immunity to @fire damage. An encased creature is freed if it would take 5 or more @fire damage. The dragon's breath freezes nonmagical liquids in the area.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: Calling on howling gales and icy rains of draconic power, white dragons may cast spells. Its spellcasting ability is WIS, spell save DC of 16, +8 to hit. The dragon requires no material components.

actions.name: Cryosnap
actions.desc: The dragon lets out a painful, resonating cry, targeting a creature it can see within range that is encased in magical ice. The creature suffers the effect of the @shatter spell, as if cast as a 5th level spell. The creature is regarded as being made of ice, and thus gains disadvantage on the saving throw.

legendaryActions.desc: The dragon may take 3 legendary actions, or 4 in its lair, choosing from the options below. Only 1 option may be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature's turn. The dragon regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

content.name: Pounce
content.desc: The dragon may move up to half its speed, and may make 1 rend attack.

name: Wing Beat
Costs 2 legendary actions
content.desc: The dragon beats its mighty, icy wings. All creatures within 10ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 16 STR saving throw, or take 2d6 @bludgeoning damage, and be knocked prone. The dragon may then move up to half its flying speed.

lairActions.desc: While the dragon is in its lair, it gains access to the following lair actions. These may be used at initiative count 20, losing initiative ties.

adult-white-dragon.source: Azzurey's Destructive Dictionary of Draconic Discord
